items.title: Objection (Einspruch) deadline against loss carryforward assessment
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bescheid binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe mit dem Einspruch anfechten, der schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der erlassenden Stelle einzulegen ist.
items.computation: Letter dated (and posted, no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' given) Mon 25.01.2027. Standard clause confirms deemed delivery on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): counting from 25.01 (not counted) → 26.01 (1), 27.01 (2), 28.01 (3), 29.01 (4) → Fri 29.01.2027, which is not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so it stays as the deemed delivery day. One-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB): ends on the day of the following month with the same number as the event day (29); February 2027 has only 28 days, so the period ends on the last day of February, Sun 28.02.2027. Because this is a Saturday/Sunday, under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day: Mon 01.03.2027 (no NRW public holiday on that date).
